lines.en: But life has begun to understand

lines.zh: 那使它诞生、也将使它消亡的力量。
lines.en: the very force that gave it birth, and will one day bring its end.

lines.zh: 倘若文明能够延续到足够遥远的未来，
lines.en: If civilization can endure into a future distant enough,

lines.zh: 我们的后代也许会尝试改写故乡的命运：
lines.en: our descendants may try to rewrite the fate of their home:

lines.zh: 在太阳与地球之间展开一面巨大的薄帆，挡住多余的阳光，
lines.en: unfurling a vast, thin sail between the Sun and the Earth to hold back the excess light,

lines.zh: 或借小行星一次次掠过的引力，把地球牵引到更温和的轨道。
lines.en: or using the pull of asteroids sweeping past again and again to tow the Earth to a gentler orbit.

lines.zh: 更大胆的设想，是在太阳步入晚年之前，
lines.en: Bolder still: before the Sun enters its old age,

lines.zh: 从它身上一点点剥离物质，
lines.en: to strip its matter away, bit by bit,

lines.zh: 把它重铸成一颗燃烧更缓慢的红矮星，
lines.en: and recast it as a red dwarf that burns far more slowly,

lines.zh: 为海洋、森林和无数尚未诞生的生命，
lines.en: to win, for the oceans, the forests, and countless lives not yet born,
a hundred billion years of time.
